column1: # Single source of truth for ryce-pc's keybindings. keys/gen.py turns it into
# hypr/binds.lua; keys/test_gen.py holds it to dotsArch's hyprland.conf, one row
# per bind there, plus the RYCE_EXTRAS allowlist written out in that test. Edit
# here, run `python3 keys/gen.py`, keep the TSV and binds.lua together.
# Columns are TAB-separated (runs of tabs are fine, for alignment):
#   mods    CTRL / SHIFT / ALT / SUPER separated by spaces, or - for none.
#           Never ALT with SHIFT: Alt+Shift is the keyboard layout switch
#           (grp:alt_shift_toggle in hypr/look.lua), so the bind would also
#           flip the layout; gen.py rejects it.
#   key     xkbcommon keysym name (Return, space, Left, Print...), or
#   action  exec close focus move resize workspace movetoworkspace focusmonitor
#           movetomonitor fullscreen float pseudo togglesplit exit drag dragresize
#           wsstep (-1 / +1: the previous / next workspace by number, empty ones
#           included, stopping at 1 and 10; past a screen's last one it goes on
#           to the other screen; Hyprland's e-1/e+1 skip empty ones)
#           call (a ryce.<name> function from hypr/*.lua, run on each press)
#   arg     the argument in Hyprland's own spelling, or - for none. The monitor
#           or l / r (the screen to the left / right; nothing happens at the edge)
#             locked  also works on the lock screen (Hyprland's bindl)
#             repeat  locked + repeats while held (Hyprland's bindel)
# -- Terminal (ryce-term = kitty in the capped ryce-agents.slice; plain kitty
#    until bin/ryce-term is deployed), close, launcher (bin/ryce-launcher: rofi
#    with the panel filled; plain rofi until it is deployed). rofi starts every
#    app (and Terminal=true ones in kitty) as its own scope in the user manager's
#    app.slice, where systemd-oomd can see and pick it; launched bare they would
#    share greetd's session scope with everything else.

column9: test -x ~/.local/bin/ryce-launcher && exec ~/.local/bin/ryce-launcher || exec rofi -show drun -theme ~/.config/rofi/style.rasi -run-command "systemd-run --user --scope --slice=app.slice --collect {cmd}" -run-shell-command "systemd-run --user --scope --slice=app.slice --collect kitty -e {cmd}"

column1: # -- Monitors: Tab cycles; the arrows go by side (the AOC left, the Samsung
#    one. CTRL+SUPER carries the window, as CTRL+SUPER+h/l do (those also cross
#    at the screen's edge); the focus and the cursor follow it. Workspaces never
#    change screen: each screen keeps its own (1-5 and 6-10 on this PC).
# -- Resize (CTRL + SHIFT + hjkl), Hyprland resizeactive deltas in px
# -- Previous/next workspace, empty ones included, stopping at 1 and 10; 5 -> 6
#    and 6 -> 5 cross to the other screen with the focus (dotsArch had e-1/e+1,
#    which skip empty ones: see RYCE_DEVIATIONS in keys/test_gen.py)
# -- Go to workspace: CTRL + 1-9, CTRL + 0 for 10. The focus goes to the screen
#    that keeps it. dotsArch's CTRL + ' (11) is gone: RYCE_DROPPED in keys/test_gen.py
# -- Move window to workspace and follow it
# -- Screenshots into ~/Pictures/Screenshots (area-copy also to the clipboard,
#    edit opens the selection in swappy)
# -- Mouse: SUPER + left drag moves, SUPER + right drag resizes
# -- Music: playerctl talks to playerctld, so it drives the player used last
#    (Aria's mpv, Feishin, a browser). SUPER+ALT + arrows for keyboards without
#    media keys: right the next song, left the previous one, space plays or
#    pauses. Locked, like the media keys, so they work over the lock screen.
#    All of them ryce extras (keys/test_gen.py RYCE_EXTRAS).
# -- ryce extras (each one is listed in keys/test_gen.py RYCE_EXTRAS)

column9: qs -c ryce ipc call sidebar toggle
qs -c ryce ipc call selector toggle
qs -c ryce ipc call desk toggle clock
